card.name: Starts of words in technology texts
card.fires_on: Short word starts such as T, alt, or .t inside URLs, names and technical terms, in web text about technology. The next piece is likely to continue a word, often one that begins with tech or sci.

modes.label: URL pieces
modes.description: Letters inside web addresses, such as t or .t after http:// or www.

modes.label: Capital T starting a sentence or name
modes.description: A lone T that begins a name or sentence near technology talk.
modes.example: how can we embrace the technology available to enhance teaching and learning. <<T>>odays teens are digital natives

modes.label: Inside technical terms
modes.description: Partway through science or energy words like surface-treatment or photovoltaic.
modes.example: turning Germany into the world's top testing ground for photovolta<<ic>> energy.

card.writes: It pushes toward tech and science word pieces such as tech, Tech and sci.
card.plain: It fires on the start or middle of odd strings, such as web addresses and names, in technology-related text.
